lead.title: Trinity College Dublin spinout Akara raises $5.5M led by Locke Health for its edge-AI thermal sensors for hospitals
lead.deck: The Dublin startup mounts thermal sensors on walls that "understand" how rooms (theatres, wards, bays) are used without filming patients or staff, with the AI running on the sensor itself; software flags key events and alerts teams, and AI agents generate reports. The round, led by Locke Health with VTC Ventures, the EIC Fund, CommonKind and NovaVector, takes total funding to $12.3M: a privacy-by-design alternative to cameras, already deployed in Ireland, the UK and the US, that now wants to accelerate hospital adoption.

milestone.title: Centinel Spine's prodisc L lumbar disc replacement wins certification under the EU MDR
milestone.summary: The prodisc L lumbar total disc replacement, a fixed-core implant (prodisc CORE technology) designed to preserve motion at the treated level rather than fuse it, is now MDR-certified, securing its continued availability in Europe. It follows the MDR certification of the prodisc C Vivo and C Nova cervical discs in September 2025; the prodisc family claims more than 300,000 implantations since 1990.
milestone.why: MDR recertification of legacy devices has become a filter: without a robust clinical file, implantables drop off the European market. A Class III implant that clears the bar keeps an edge among alternatives to spinal fusion, and shows the regulatory cost spine startups will also have to absorb.

brefsEurope.title: SciBase has filed a 510(k) to extend Nevisense to non-melanoma skin cancers as Q3 sales jump 41%
brefsEurope.summary: The Swedish electrical-impedance skin cancer detection specialist has submitted an indication expansion for Nevisense to the FDA; quarterly sales reached SEK 14.6M (+41%), driven by the US (+68% in skin cancer). An NIH–SIAF study (THREAT) will use Nevisense as its primary endpoint, and a fully underwritten rights issue of about SEK 57.5M funds the next steps.

brefsEurope.title: Parsys Télémédecine, in liquidation, is taken over by its former CTO and becomes Parsys Medical
brefsEurope.summary: The French maker of telemedicine stations for remote areas (connected ECGs), in receivership since July 21, saw the takeover bid of Jean-Christophe Bohin, co-founder of product studio Matters and the company's former technical director, accepted in early November. A reminder of how fragile telehealth hardware makers are, even with institutional customers.

brefsIntl.title: New CPT codes for endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD) receive their 2027 Medicare valuation
brefsIntl.summary: CMS published final valuations and 2027 Medicare rates for CPT codes 43498 (upper GI ESD) and 45991 (lower GI ESD), effective January 1, 2027. A US reimbursement unlock that opens the market for therapeutic endoscopy tools and robots, including European ones.

brefsIntl.title: Tandem corrects more than 80,000 Mobi insulin pumps after 230 adverse events
brefsIntl.summary: Increased friction in the drive module can trigger false occlusion alarms that suspend insulin delivery; 230 events requiring medical intervention or hospitalization had been reported as of Oct. 29, with no deaths. It is the Mobi's second recall of 2026, as its tubeless version nears the end of FDA review.

word.definition: A technique that removes a cancerous or precancerous lesion of the digestive tract in one piece by "peeling" it off the wall from the inside with an endoscope, with no incision and no organ removal.

how.t: The lesion is outlined, then fluid is injected under the mucosa to lift it off the muscle layer.
An electrosurgical knife cuts around the lesion and gradually peels it away, layer by layer, under endoscopic vision.
The lesion comes out whole (en bloc), allowing reliable margin analysis; the wall is closed if needed.

word.why: ESD spares some patients major surgery (removing part of the colon or stomach), but it is long and difficult, so rarely performed in the West. Two barriers are falling: reimbursement (new US CPT codes effective in 2027) and technical difficulty, which robotic platforms and traction devices aim to make accessible to more endoscopists. A market for endoscopy tools and robots is opening up.
